```{r}
save.image("data/20251106_1.RData") #saved 11/21 2/4

load("data/20251106.RData")
load("data/20251106_1.RData")


samples <- list.files("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/data/xenium")
clean_samples <- samples[!grepl("\\.zarr$", samples)]

sm_folders <- (paste0("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/data/xenium/", clean_samples))

stList <- list()

for (i in seq_along(clean_samples)) {
  print(i)
  stList[[i]] <- LoadXenium(sm_folders[i],
                         fov = "fov", segmentations="cell", flip.xy=TRUE)
  stList[[i]]$sample <- clean_samples[i]
  stList[[i]]$age <- ifelse(grepl("_Y", clean_samples[i]), "Young", "Old")
}

#Without any filtering, Check the spot numbers of each section
lapply(stList, ncol) %>% unlist()

tmp = stList[[1]]
ImageFeaturePlot(tmp, features = "nCount_Xenium")



```

```{r}

for (i in seq_along(stList)) {

}
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4)
```

```{r}
# based on the histogram plot, here we choose 20 transcript counts as lower cutoff

plots = list()

for (i in seq_along(stList)) {
    plots[[i]] = hist(stList[[i]]$nCount_Xenium, xlim=c(0,200), breaks = 5000)
    abline(v = 10, col="red")
}
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)

for (i in seq_along(stList)) {
    stList[[i]]<- subset(stList[[i]], subset = nCount_Xenium >= 10)
}

hsskin.ST <- merge(stList[[1]], 
                    y = stList[2:length(stList)], 
                    add.cell.ids = clean_samples, 
                    project = "hsskin.ST")



```

```{r}
hsskin.ST <- IntegrateLayers(hsskin.ST, method = HarmonyIntegration,
                             orig = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony",
                             dims = 1:30)

# UMAP analysis based on batch-corrected Harmony space
# runtime: 1min

                    return.model = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, , n.neighbors=100)

hsskin.ST <- FindNeighbors(hsskin.ST, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30,  k.param= 100)
hsskin.ST <- FindClusters(hsskin.ST, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

DimPlot(hsskin.ST, label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE)
```

```{r}
prep_FindMarkers <- function(obj, num_slices = 6) {
  # Loop through total number slices
  for (i in 1:num_slices) {
    slot(object = obj@assays$SCT@SCTModel.list[[i]], name = "umi.assay") <- "Xenium"
  }
  obj <- obj %>% PrepSCTFindMarkers()
  # Return the modified obj
  return(obj)}

hsskin.ST<- prep_FindMarkers(hsskin.ST)

# calculate marker genes for each cluster
all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(hsskin.ST, only.pos = TRUE)

# Save the 'all.markers' data frame to a file named "all_markers.csv"
write.csv(all.markers, file = "results/all_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

top10 <- all.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)
a=DoHeatmap(hsskin.ST, features = top10$gene, slot='data')

a <- DoHeatmap(hsskin.ST, features = unique(top10$gene))
ggsave("heatmap.png", plot = a, width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 100)

DotPlot(hsskin.ST, features = unique(top10$gene), cols = c("blue", "red"), dot.scale = 2) +
  
  # 2. Improve Readability (optional but recommended)
  # Transpose the plot for better gene label viewing
  RotatedAxis() +
  
  # 3. Add a Title (optional)
  labs(title = "Top 10 Markers per Cluster")

```

```{r}
  ) +

    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Display the plot
print(stacked_barplot)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Define the groups based on your specific cell types
immune_list <- c("Dendritic Cell", "Langerhans Cell", "Mast Cell", "Plasma Cell", "T-Cell")

skin_list <- c("Keratinocyte", "Fibroblast", "Melanocyte", "Epithelial Cell", 
               "Endothelial Cell", "Smooth Muscle Cell", "Stromal/Endothelial/Lymphatic-related")

# 2. Add the category to your Xenium object metadata
hsskin.ST@meta.data <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cell_lineage = case_when(
    cell_type_major %in% immune_list ~ "Immune Cells",
    cell_type_major %in% skin_list   ~ "Skin Cells",
    TRUE ~ "Other" # For Proliferating Cells or unassigned
  ))


get_cells_df <- function(obj, lineage) {
  # 1. Extract metadata only to bypass FOV errors
  meta_df <- obj@meta.data
  
  # 2. Filter metadata and calculate frequencies
  # Note: Using 'Sample_ID' based on your previous plots
  df <- meta_df %>%
    filter(cell_lineage == lineage) %>%
    group_by(age, cell_type_major) %>%
    tally(name = "Freq") %>%
    # 3. Calculate Proportion and Percentage per Sample
    group_by(age) %>%
    mutate(
      Total = sum(Freq),
      Proportion = Freq / Total,
      Percentage = round(Proportion * 100, 1)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # 4. Rename to match your ggplot 'Var1' and 'Var2' names
    rename(Var1 = age, Var2 = cell_type_major)
  
  return(as.data.frame(df))
}

# Create the two dataframes
cells_immune <- get_cells_df(hsskin.ST, "Immune Cells")
cells_skin <- get_cells_df(hsskin.ST, "Skin Cells")

#### Immune Cells
ggplot(cells_immune, aes(x = Var1, y = Proportion, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 2, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Immune Cell Types",
    x = "Sample_ID",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Immune Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )


#### Skin Cells
ggplot(cells_skin, aes(x = Var1, y = Proportion, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 2, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Skin Cell Types",
    x = "Sample_ID",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Skin Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

```{r}
# Explicit marker list for R DotPlot
# Shortened marker list for R DotPlot to prevent cutoff
marker_list <- list(
  "Basal_K"   = c("KRT15", "KRT5", "KRT14", "APCDD1"),
  "Sup_Gra_K" = c("KRT1", "KRT10", "FLG", "KLK5", "TMEM45A", "DEFB1", "FABP5"),
  "Melano"    = c("MLANA", "DCT", "TFAP2B", "TYR"),
  "Fibro"     = c("LGR5", "COL1A1", "COL6A1", "COL6A2", "COL6A3", "GEM"),
  "Endo"      = c("VWF", "CD34", "SOX17", "GYPC"),
  "SM_Peri"   = c("ACTA2", "MYH11", "LGR6"),
  "Lang" = c("CD207", "CD1A"),
  "Eccrine"   = c("DCD"),
  "Hair"      = c("WNT2B"),
  "Immune" = c("PTPRC")
)

# --- Recommended Plotting Code for Visibility ---
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'cell_type_major'

DotPlot(hsskin.ST, features = marker_list) + 
  # 1. Flip the plot so cell types are on the Y-axis and genes on X
  #coord_flip() + 
  # 2. Rotate gene names 45 degrees
  RotatedAxis() +
  # 3. Fine-tune text size and plot margins
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),      # Size of the "Basal_K" labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),       # Size of the Gene labels
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6), 
    # Optional: reduce the angle or adjust spacing if they still overlap
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)        # Adds extra space around the plot
  )
```

```{r immune_subclustering}
# Create the 'immune_cell' metadata column
hsskin.ST@meta.data$immune_cell <- ifelse(
  hsskin.ST@meta.data$cell_type_major %in% c("T-Cell", "Mast Cell", "Dendritic Cell"),
  "immune cell", 
  "non-immune cell"
)

hsskin.ST <- UpdateSeuratObject(hsskin.ST) #updating because there was an issue with subsetting
hsskin.immune <- subset(hsskin.ST, subset = immune_cell == "immune cell")

saveRDS(hsskin.immune, file = "hsskin.immune.rds")
saveRDS(hsskin.ST, file = "skin_mapping/data/hsskin.ST.rds")

# Optional: Check the distribution to verify
table(hsskin.ST@meta.data$cell_type_major, hsskin.ST@meta.data$immune_cell)

Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'immune_cell'

hsskin.ST <- FindSubCluster(hsskin.ST, cluster="immune cell", graph.name="SCT_snn", subcluster.name="immune_subclusters",  resolution = 0.5)
DimPlot(hsskin.ST, reduction = "umap", group.by = "prolif", label = TRUE, label.size = 6)

marker_immune <- list(

)

Idents(hsskin.ST) <- 'immune_subclusters'
```

```{r}
Xen_data <- readRDS("Xenium_data_clustered_annotated.rds")
as.AnnData(Xen_data, assay = "Xenium", file = "Xen_adata_annotated.h5ad")

library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("scverse", required = T)


from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import scanpy as sc
import squidpy as sq
sc.logging.print_header()

adata = sc.read_h5ad("Xen_adata_annotated.h5ad")
adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, inplace=True)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 7))
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(adata, library_key = "library_id", library_id = "Assay1", 
                      color=["CellType"], shape=None, size=1, img = False, ax=ax[0])
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(adata, library_key = "library_id", library_id = "Assay3", 
                      color=["CellType"], shape=None, size=1, img = False, ax=ax[1])
plt.show(ax)

sq.gr.nhood_enrichment(adata, cluster_key="CellType")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 7))
sq.pl.nhood_enrichment(adata, cluster_key="CellType", figsize=(8, 8), 
                       title="Neighborhood enrichment adata", ax=ax[0])
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(adata, color="CellType", library_key = "library_id", 
                      library_id = "Assay1", shape=None, size=2, ax=ax[1])
plt.show(ax)
```
